name: Abhimanyu Shekhawat
description:
Abhimanyu is a Co-founder of Epoch Protocol, an intent-centric abstraction layer for web3. He has been in the space for 7 years, and his previous venture, Orange Wallet, was acquired by a large fintech.

He has worked with major projects including Avail, Polygon, Spheron, and Hyperledger, with contributions across Slither, Ethereum.org, and WalletConnect.

Epoch began as pure web3 infrastructure and grew into bringing fintechs onto the same rails, through abstraction and compliant privacy.
